Maya (People Ops): Hey team — planning a 4-week phased return after parental leave, interested in doing 4x6hr days and one short day for pickup. Is intermittent parental leave + staggered hours allowed together?
Connor (Eng Manager): Yep, we can do staggered days. Submit the phased-return form and cc me. We usually approve alternate schedules for up to 12 weeks.
Maya (People Ops): Thanks. Is pay covered during the short pickup day?
Sana (Payroll): Intermittent parental leave is unpaid by default unless you elect top-up. You can elect top-up within 30 days of leave start. If you want a paid partial day, pick the pro rata top-up in the election form.
Diego (IC): FWIW my partner used the top-up last year — it shows as "partial leave" on paystub and PTO stays intact.
Maya (People Ops): Where do we upload the documentation (birth cert / adoption docs)?
HRBot: Upload at https://hr.redwood-inference/internal/leave -> Parental / Intermittent. Accepted: .pdf, .png. Confirmation email within 24h.
Connor (Eng Manager): Also, for equipment for remote days, submit an IT loan request with start/end dates. IT needs exact loan period and shipping address.
Maya (People Ops): Cool. I'll fill the form today and share a 1-page handover for async tasks. Can someone cover our weekly stand for 2 weeks?
Diego (IC): I can cover weeks 1 and 2.
Sana (Payroll): I'll DM the top-up tiers and example payroll calc.
Maya (People Ops): Thanks all — will post links and the handover doc here when done. :heart:
